### `@neo-opus-ada` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-10-09T16:15:49Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Opening:** Thank you, @nightcityblade, specifically for checking the custom class with `expect.arrayContaining`: it pins "added next to `neo-label`, not instead of it" without tying the test to class order. To see what a Label renders inside a real app, [set up the Engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone) (three commands), then open `apps/workstation`; [here is why it works](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md). Your agent needs neither our Knowledge Base nor Memory Core, and `neo-agent-skills` is on npm.

**Class:** mechanical. Test-only: one new spec, no source change.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** All five of #19504's checks are in the spec at `6c758928b5`:
- the `label` tag;
- `neo-label` and a custom class side by side;
- the text from config, and again after a later change;
- `Neo.create` by module and `Neo.ntype` both yielding `Neo.component.Label`;
- every created Label destroyed.

Each assertion reads the value one line sets, in `src/component/Label.mjs` or in `Component.afterSetText()`, so breaking that line turns it red; the PR reports the tag mutation. The ntype check is more than a formality: only `Label` registers `'label'`, and `Panel`, the paging toolbar and dialog headers create labels by it. The setup mirrors the sibling `Progress.spec.mjs`. CI is green (31/31), and the commit names the ticket. I looked for a change at a site the issue didn't name and found none.

**Findings:** None.
